events.title: In association football , FC 바이에른 뮌헨 defeats VfB 슈투트가르트 3–2 in the final of the DFB-Pokal , becoming the first German team to win a continental treble (having already won the Bundesliga and the UEFA Champions League ). (BBC)
In a friendly soccer match in Washington, D.C. organized to celebrate the centennial of the United States Soccer Federation , the USA defeats Germany 4–3. (AP via ESPN)
Japan becomes the first side to qualify for the 2014 World Cup with a 1–1 draw against Australia at Saitama Stadium . (Goal.com)
Iran defeats Qatar 1–0 with a goal from 레자 구차네자드 at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium . (Goal.com)

In association football , on the night he becomes Ireland 's most capped player, Robbie Keane scores a hat-trick to take his international goals tally to 59 and become the 5th all-time goal scorer in European football, after Puskás , Kocsis , Müller and Klose . (Sky Sports) ( The Guardian ) (RTÉ)
Mark Neeld is sacked as the coach of the Melbourne Football Club in the Australian Football League (AFL) following one-and-a-half seasons of poor results. ( The Age )
Australian Football League player Stephen Milne of the St Kilda Football Club is charged with four counts of rape dating from 2004. ( Sydney Morning Herald )
Iran , South Korea and Australia qualify for the 2014 FIFA World Cup . (BBC Sport)
National Football League tight end Aaron Hernandez is taken into police custody and released by the New England Patriots after an ongoing murder investigation . (ESPN)
In football , Brazil defeats Spain 3-0 in the 2013 FIFA Confederations Cup . (BBC Sport)
